_comment: Tandem Lookout's soulbond pairs with the NIV (draw_trigger_damage) over the other legal partner, and its MANDATORY grant runs the loop to the kill without decking us. Mid-turn frame (resume_at main1, land drop spent): a summoning-sick Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind, a Goblin Guide, four Islands; hand Tandem Lookout + Preordain. Lookout ({2}{U}) enters and pairs with the Niv, Preordain ({U}) draws, the draw pings, the pinging Niv draws (Lookout's grant), ... until the opponent is at 0. Library exactly 40 -- the loop must stop at the kill (20 draws), not run on. Fails if the pairing lands on the Guide, if the grant breaks, or if the loop overruns into a deck-out.
